expected.title: Every quasi-compact quasi-separated algebraic space over the integers is an affine-transition inverse limit of finite-type quasi-separated integer algebraic spaces
expected.author: The Stacks Project Authors
expected.difficulty_reason: The theorem builds finite-type integer models of an arbitrary qcqs algebraic space through finite Nisnevich filtration, relative scheme approximation and explicit gluing of finite-stage etale equivalence relations. This non-schematic approximation/effectiveness construction is substantially beyond routine scheme descent or formal parameter changes.

expected.author: The Stacks Project Authors
expected.difficulty_reason: The proof must identify the crystal Cech resolution with a de Rham complex through a two-directional double-complex argument.
